thread:
Alex: FYI — Prospect PierBridge is asking for a phased swap from CompetitorY. Goals: minimal client changes, output parity for their storefront prompts, token billing reconciliation, and on-prem fallback. Can we surface the main technical/legal blockers?
Jess: Quick question — do they expect exact SDK parity or just that their clients don't have to change callsite code? Sales said "transparent swap" so aim for minimal callsite diffs.
Samir: From eng: biggest technical risks are tokenizer mismatches (leads to subtle rerank/order changes), different stop-sequence semantics, and sampling default differences. Also they use a custom session header X-PB-SESSION for stateful flows.
Olga: Tokenization shim plan: normalize NFC unicode, collapse repeated whitespace, and apply a small token mapping table for top 50 divergences. It's not perfect but often reduces top-1 deltas. We can also offer a client-side compat helper lib.
Alex: Can Dedicated/Private honor their X-PB-SESSION sticky routing?
Samir: Yes — we can do header-based affinity to a Dedicated pool. Need perf validation at their expected concurrency. I'll schedule load tests once staging is up.
Meera (Legal): They require no-training clause, 90-day retention, and exportable audit logs. We'll need to produce an addendum and confirm HSM/KMS compatibility.
Olga: We support customer-managed KMS and HSM keywrap in Private. I'll prep SOC2 extracts and a KMS integration note. Also list of IPs for allowlist.
deploy-bot: Presales env requested: pierbridge-compat-shim v0.1 -> presales-staging (job 54901).
Jess: Pricing ask  they'd like a delta comparison if we run quantized models. Samir, can you give a quick $/1k token range and latency hit for 8k-ish sequence workloads?
Samir: Ballpark: quantized on Dedicated ~0.5-0.75x per-token cost vs CompetitorY (depends on batch util). Latency: p50 ~+8-18%, p95 +12-35% vs CompetitorY depending on concurrency. I'll produce a conservative table.
Alex: Proposed POC acceptance criteria: 1) Top-1 intent/intent-slot parity >=94% on their eval set; 2) p95 latency within 30% of CompetitorY; 3) reconciliation script that maps their token CSV to our billing and shows <=12% variance after normalization; 4) contractual no-training + 90d retention in place. 2-week POC target.
Jess: Ask to customer: eval set (JSONL), sample billing export from CompetitorY, staging allowlist IPs, and which endpoints have highest traffic. I'll request these today.
Olga: I'll drop SOC2 excerpt, HSM notes, and allowlist IPs into the presales folder and ping infra for IP openings.
Samir: Smoke test for the shim (share with customer):
```
curl -X POST https://staging.redwood-inference.internal/v1/pierbridge-shim/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "X-PB-SESSION: 77f2a9" \
  -d '{"prompt":"<their prompt>","max_tokens":256,"stop":["\n\n"]}'
```
Alex: Action items: Samir -> baseline CompetitorY runs + cost sheet; Jess -> request eval set + billing CSV + allowlist; Olga -> security docs & KMS configs; Meera -> draft addendum for no-training/retention.
Meera (Legal): I'll draft addendum and loop in contracts; flagging exportable audit log format requirement (CSV + JSON).
Samir: Timeline note  2 weeks is realistic if we get the eval/billing CSV and allowlist by start-of-week Monday. Otherwise add a week.
Jess: :white_check_mark: I'll chase them now.
Alex: Good work team — I'll update PierBridge with acceptance criteria and target dates. Marking thread presales-pierbridge for follow-up.
